artworks.title: The Monarchist
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on zinc
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract bending figure with elongated limbs over a textured landscape resembling rough terrain or stone. The figure's form suggests a deep stretch or balance, with its smooth curve resembling an arc. Above the scene is a sun with radiating lines. The composition merges human form with elements of nature, blending the organic and abstract.

artworks.title: Zwei Männer, einander in höherer Stellung vermutend, begegnen sich (Two Men Meet, Each Believing the Other to Be of Higher Rank
artworks.medium: etching on zinc
artworks.description: The image shows two elongated, curved figures with exaggerated limbs, bending towards each other in a posture that creates an abstract and surreal scene. The figures resemble hunched, anthropomorphic beings with features that connect them to familiar creatures such as humans and apes. Their bent arms and legs form sinewy, distorted lines that contrast with the rocky surface they stand on. The figures appear engaged in a silent conversation in the abstract composition.

artworks.title: The Boston Massacre
artworks.medium: engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and shading and then painted, a row of seven red-uniformed soldiers to the right fire rifles into a crowd of dozens in a town square in this vertical engraving. The soldiers are led by an eighth behind the line, who raises a sword. Blood gushes from wounded people to the left, who wear clothing in shades of marine and sky blue and brick red. A small brown dog stands near one dead person along the bottom of the composition, and two- and three-story buildings enclose the rectangular square behind the action. The sky is tinted blue along the top of the print, and a crescent moon is in the top left corner. An inscription near the dog in the image reads, “Engrav’d Printed & Sold by Paul Revere Boston.” Printed text over the image reads, “The Bloody Massacre perpetuated in King Street Boston on March 5th 1770 by a party of the 29th Regt.” Three columns of text below read, “Unhappy Boston! See thy Sons deplore, They hallowed Walks besmear’d with guiltless Gore. While faithless P—n and his savage Bands, With murd’rous Rancour stretch their bloody Hands; Like fierce Barbarainas grinning o’er their Prey, Approve the Carnage and enjoy the Day. If sealding drops from Rage from Anguish Wrung, If speeches Sorrows lab’ring for a Tongue, Or if a weeping World can ought appease, The plaintive Ghosts of Victims such as these; The Patriot’s copious Tears for each are shed, A glorious Tribute which embalms the Dead. But know, Fat summons to that awful Goal, Where Justice strips the Murd’rer of his Soul: Should venal C—ts the scandal of the Land, Snatch the relentless Villain from her Hand, Keen Execrations on this Plate inscribed, Shall reach a Judge who never can be brib’d.” Cursive printed script below reads, “The unhappy Sufferers were Sam’l Gray, Sam’l Maverick, Jam’s Caldwell, Crispus Attacuks & Pat’k Carr Killed. Six wounded, two of them (Christ’r Monk and John Clark) Mortally.”

artworks.title: Simon Lord Lovat
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man sitting on a chair, with his body visible from head to knees. He is positioned slightly turned to his right, with his hands resting on his waist. The man has curly hair, a prominent chin, high-arched eyebrows, and a wide smile. He is wearing a long coat, knee-length breeches, and stockings. Surrounding him are an ornate chair, a wooden writing table with a book open and a quill in an ink pot. The background consists of parallel lines, highlighting the figure.

artworks.title: Apres l'attentat, Juin '97
artworks.medium: brush and black ink watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows a figure in a chair at a table. The scene includes a person sitting in a chair at one end of a table. On the table, there is an open book, a pot of ink, and a quill pen. The style is simple, using minimal lines and shading. Ink is used as the medium for a sketch-like appearance.

artworks.title: At the Peace Conference
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched scene with two individuals depicted in a minimalistic and somewhat abstract style. One person is standing, slightly bent forward, while the other is seated and facing to the side. The standing figure has a long face with prominent cheekbones, almond-shaped eyes, a long nose, and a mouth turned downward. They wear a long, dark garment with a head covering. The seated figure is partially covered with a robe or cloak and also wears a head covering. The background is minimalistic, with bare lines suggesting a corner and providing a stark contrast to the detailed figures.

artworks.title: a) Au congres de la Paix (recto); b) Untitled (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
b) graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated person from the side. The person, likely a woman, is depicted with their upper body, face, and full legs visible. They appear to be turned slightly towards the viewer with their hands resting on their lap. The person has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, and is wearing a headscarf covering their hair partially. Their clothing is illustrated as a flowing garment, possibly a dress or robe, with bold strokes suggesting fabric folds. Another person, possibly a man, is sketched in profile on the right, leaning slightly forward as if conversing with the seated figure. He is depicted with his head and shoulders visible, along with a bald head and distinct facial features. The background is bare, with sketch lines hinting at architectural elements or furnishings. The focus of the sketch is the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: A Versailles juillet 1919
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a man sitting on a chair beside a table. He is leaning forward with his arms crossed and resting on the table, his head slightly bowed. He has short, dark hair and is wearing a suit. On the table, there is an inkwell with a feather quill. The background is plain.

artworks.title: À la conférence (At the Conference)
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink and black crayon on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures in a monochromatic sketch. One man is seated at a table, leaning slightly forward, engaged in an activity. He has a bald head and wears glasses, with a distinct nose and pointed facial features. The other man stands opposite him, with a shaved head and pronounced features. He wears a robe with broad lapels, and one arm rests by his side. The background is blank, and there are light sketches indicating the table and a square piece of paper. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: a) Negotiations at the Trianon Palace, Versailles (recto); b) Study for Negotiations at the Trianon Palace, Versailles (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink over graphite on wove paper
b) brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up standing with his arms resting on a railing. He is leaning forward slightly with his head turned downward and to the side. The man has a face with a mustache, wearing a hat that covers his hair. He is dressed in a coat or jacket over a vest, with visible folds in the fabric. There are faint sketches of other figures and abstract lines around him, along with minimal architectural elements in the background. The man is not wearing any visible jewelry or accessories.

artworks.title: La France attend (France Waits)
artworks.medium: black crayon and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with crossed arms. Their head is turned to the side. The person has a simple sketch of facial features, straight hair under a red hat, and is wearing a light blue dress with long sleeves and a belt. A dark bag or pouch hangs at their side. The background has faint outlines of rocks or mountains, without specific features to indicate a location.

artworks.title: France Watching
artworks.medium: brush and gray and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a minimalist drawing of a cloaked figure standing on a rocky cliff. The scene is rendered in soft black and gray tones on paper. The figure, draped in flowing garments, appears to gaze out into a vast landscape dominated by the sky. The drawing uses brushstrokes to convey texture and an atmospheric effect suggesting contemplation or solitude. The surroundings are sketch-like with few details, emphasizing the silhouette and mood. Light and shadow create depth and a sense of vastness beyond the figure's sight.

artworks.title: M. Clemenceau.  La lettre du Cte Czernin
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a simple line drawing of two figures. The first individual is shown in profile, facing right, with basic facial features and bald head. They wear a long-sleeved garment and hold a tool connected to an abstract shape. A second figure is outlined to the right, facing forward and observing the first person. The background is plain.

artworks.title: C'est la Paix.  Tu vois pas un kepi!
artworks.medium: brush and black ink over black crayon on wove paper (tracing paper)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a room. One man stands in profile wearing a suit with a long coat, and he has a bald head with a mustache. The other man is seated at a table, leaning slightly back with one arm resting on the table. He has a monocle and a mustache, and he is bald. He is wearing a formal suit with a bow tie. On the table, there are top hats and bowler hats scattered and stacked haphazardly. The background is simple, with light shadow lines suggesting a wall behind them. No additional decorative elements are present in the image.

artworks.title: The Tuileries Garden (Le jardin des Tuileries)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on china paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pathway from a low perspective. The horizon is high, with trees and figures in the distance. Close to the viewer are birds on grass with loose brushstrokes. Further along, figures in 19th-century clothing walk on the path. The style has soft brush strokes and pastel colors like green, yellow, and beige, giving a serene atmosphere. The color palette emphasizes green, yellow, and neutral tones.

artworks.title: Bust of a Balding Man
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut with light brown tone block
artworks.description: The image shows the head and upper part of the shoulders of an older man. His facial features include prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, a high forehead, and a furrowed brow. His hair is thin and receding, with some curls and sparse strands on top and around the sides and back. The man's expression is neutral, and he has a few visible wrinkles and textured skin. He is dressed in a simple garment with a loose collar and a small tie detail at the neck. There is no jewelry or objects visible. The background is plain with a linear pattern of horizontal lines. The image appears to be a woodcut or engraving style with a stark black and white contrast.

artworks.title: Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth and the Infant Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.1 x 16.3 cm (5 3/16 x 6 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows four figures, with two women and two children forming the central focus. The bodies of the women are shown almost in full, sitting on the ground amidst tree trunks and a rustic woven fence. One woman is seated upright, with her hair neatly styled and possibly covered with a headscarf. The second woman, on her side, has her hair similarly styled under a cloth, leaning towards the first woman. Each woman is holding a child who appear to be toddlers with wavy hair. The women are dressed in Renaissance-style clothing with long, flowing garments featuring layers and detailed patterns. One child sits on a lap, and the other is held next to the second woman. To the left, an older bearded man is shown in profile, partially obscured by the tree structure. He is dressed in a cloak, standing or kneeling slightly away from the group. The background consists of an intricate forest scene with a mix of thick tree trunks and open skies, providing a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Philippe le Roy, Lord of Ravels
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait sketch of an individual from the shoulders up. The person is positioned slightly turned to the left, gazing directly forward. The individual has wavy hair falling to the collar, with facial features such as arched brows, deep-set eyes, a mustache, and a pointed chin with a small beard. The person wears what seems to be a cloak with a decorative pattern on the shoulders. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the portrait. There is no visible jewelry or other objects.

artworks.title: Faust
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.2 x 16.2 cm (8 3/8 x 6 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person leaning slightly forward with one hand resting on a table, looking towards a glowing orb or symbol in front of a leaded glass window. The person has a long face with pronounced features, including a prominent nose, and is wearing a cap that covers their hair. Their clothing appears loose-fitting, with a richly textured robe featuring a distinctive pattern on the shoulder edges. The surroundings are dimly lit, emphasizing the circular, illuminated object on the window that contains letters and symbols. The background includes a curtained area to one side and a partially visible sculpture or relief on the wall. The setting seems to be an interior space filled with various objects and textures, adding to the complexity of the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with a View toward Haarlem (The Goldweigher's Field)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.3 x 31.9 cm (4 13/16 x 12 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic landscape with fields, a town, and a sky. The perspective is elevated. The town is in the distance near the horizon, with some spires and structures visible. The drawing style is similar to an etching with fine lines and detailed textures for trees and buildings. The color scheme is mainly monochromatic, using dark ink for contrast. Fields with light vegetation lead to a central area with more foliage and buildings. In the far background, the town's silhouette is seen. The sky is clear and occupies a significant portion of the image.

artworks.title: Man in a Fantastic Helmet
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body in profile facing right. The individual wears an ornate and fantastical helmet with intricate designs depicting mythical creatures. Their facial features are well-defined, and the hair is styled in curls visible beneath the helmet. The armor is adorned with flowers and mythical creatures. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: The Daughters of Sir Thomas Frankland
artworks.medium: mezzotint
artworks.description: The image depicts two women sitting closely together on the ground. The woman on the left has one arm around the shoulder of the woman on the right and the other around a dog lying beside her. Both women are looking slightly upward and to the left. The woman on the left has curly hair, while the one on the right wears a headscarf. They have soft expressions and delicate features. Both are dressed in flowing gowns, with the woman on the right holding a folded piece of fabric or a book. A dog lays at their feet, partially covered with fabric. The background shows a landscape with clouds, a large tree, rolling hills, and trees.

artworks.title: La Torre di Malghera
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a waterway and a structure-filled shoreline. The horizon is below the midpoint, with a line of distant hills meeting the sky. A tall tower is on the right, with smaller buildings to the left. The style is detailed engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on light paper. There are boats in the water, people on a raft-like vessel, and individuals wading near the shore. A small dock is visible on the left.
